# Profile-specific values for the self-contained local Builder/Mock-User profile.
# (git-ignored local config; populated in this workspace to enable local-builder.)

SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=local-builder
SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000

# Mock-User / Builder auth (SVA_MOCK_AUTH / VITE_MOCK_AUTH are the legacy aliases
# that the runtime-profile validator requires; profile-env re-asserts them on top).
SVA_MOCK_AUTH=true
VITE_MOCK_AUTH=true
VITE_PUBLIC_BUILDER_KEY=<redacted-present>
